LanguageData.Gun_MAS-36_RWP.description: The MAS-36 is a bolt-action rifle known for its durability and simplicity, emanating from a pre-industrial era. Though it lacks the rate of fire typical of modern weaponry, its accuracy and reliability make it a dependable choice for mid-range engagements, ideal for colonists who can take their time to aim carefully.
